name: Wizard OS 0.3.104 — 0.3.103 with App Manager 525e9d3d -> 17c8d9c (private app-data permissions, owner proof, nightly maintenance)
about: Latest 0.3.103 with the App Manager moved from 525e9d3d to 17c8d9cd (official main). Merged since: humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#457 Recommended fix: preserve private app-data permissions through install and update; #450 Owner proof: enrolled owner device + host access only from the owner; #447 maintain: nightly maintenance with removable root helper; #455 fix: bootstrap Docker before Runtipi on Debian cloud images; #448 docs; and the 0.3.103 release mirror. Wizard UX, Agent Service, Troubleshooter, Hermes and the default apps are unchanged. Cut for Messenger's single Standard release, which needs #457 on every owner's box. Stable stays 0.3.102 until the installed upgrade test passes.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.
